transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Thanks, Dr. Smith. I guess I'm here because I've just hit a wall. I just don’t see things getting better anymore, no matter what I do.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

Yeah, I really have. I used to love going to museums, playing my guitar, and hiking along the Palisades, but I've stopped doing all of that. I've even been turning down invites from a long-time hiking buddy because I just don't have the energy anymore, so my social life has pretty much dried up.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this low mood been going on for at least two weeks or longer?

It’s been a lot longer than two weeks, to be honest. This heavy, stuck feeling has been hanging over me pretty much nonstop for a little over two years now. It really started around the time I first opened my furniture studio and just hasn't let up since.
Have there been any periods during these two years when you felt completely back to your usual self, even for a few weeks?
No, there really haven't been any breaks where I felt like my old self again. This low, stuck feeling has been hanging over me pretty much nonstop for the entire two years since I started the studio.

The absence of significant anxiety symptoms or episodic improvement rules out F41. Thus, the current candidate is F33.
